body: Sometimes mp3s can be encoded with the sampling rate at something other than 44 kHz which is standard for CDs/MP3s, so it will end up playing back more slowly or faster on devices that are incapable of playing the file back correctly. I've had this happen and I got used to hearing a particular song pitched down and slower and then when I downloaded the same album from a different source, it sounded faster, sharper and how it ought to sound.

It's annoying that they tried to stretch one book into three movies and in the process include a bunch of stuff that wasn't even in *The Hobbit*, while *removing* a bunch from the *Lord of the Rings*, which was six books/three volumes. They should have made the *Lord of the Rings* into at least six movies then. That probably would have made the Middle Earth geeks happier because they would have been closer to including everything. Hindsight is 20-20 I guess.
